_comment: Map overlay for the game screen's Map panel (2026-11-02). The base layer is a modern unlabeled map (CARTO 'dark_nolabels', built on OpenStreetMap data): central St Petersburg's river, canal and street plan is largely unchanged since 1917, and leaving modern labels off avoids anachronistic names. Landmarks and barracks are placed by hand. Landmark positions are reliable; barracks positions are approximate (regimental quarters moved and sprawled, and several reserve battalions were spread over more than one site) - good enough to show which side of the river a regiment sits on, not for navigation.
